info.title: Kalshi Perps WebSocket API
info.description:
WebSocket API for receiving real-time market data notifications and updates on Kalshi perps markets.

Supported channels:
- `orderbook_delta`
- `ticker`
- `trade`
- `fill`
- `user_orders`
- `order_group_updates`

tags.name: control-frames
tags.description: WebSocket control frames for connection management

production.description: Production margin WebSocket server (encrypted connection only)

demo.description: Demo margin WebSocket server (encrypted connection only)

root.title: WebSocket Connection
root.description:
Main WebSocket connection endpoint.
Authentication is required during the WebSocket handshake.

control_frames.title: Connection Keep-Alive
control_frames.description:
Kalshi sends Ping frames every 10 seconds with body `heartbeat`.
Clients should respond with Pong frames.

orderbook_delta.title: Orderbook Updates
orderbook_delta.description:
Real-time margin orderbook price-level changes.

Requirements:
- authenticated connection
- market specification required via `market_ticker` or `market_tickers`
- sends `orderbook_snapshot` first, then incremental `orderbook_delta` updates
- supports `get_snapshot` on `update_subscription` to request a fresh snapshot without changing the subscription

ticker.title: Market Ticker
ticker.description:
Margin market updates are delivered on a single channel. `ticker` messages include
price, top-of-book size, volume, open-interest, and optional reference/mark prices.

Messages are coalesced to at most one per market per second (latest value wins
within the window).

Requirements:
- no additional channel-level auth beyond the authenticated WebSocket connection
- market specification optional
- supports `market_ticker`/`market_tickers`

trade.title: Public Trades
trade.description:
Public notifications for executed margin trades.

Requirements:
- no additional channel-level auth beyond the authenticated WebSocket connection
- market specification optional via `market_ticker` or `market_tickers`

fill.title: User Fills
fill.description:
Private fill notifications for the authenticated user on the margin exchange.

Requirements:
- authenticated connection
- market specification optional via `market_ticker` or `market_tickers`
- supports `update_subscription` with `add_markets` and `delete_markets`

user_orders.title: User Orders
user_orders.description:
Private order created/updated notifications for the authenticated user on the margin exchange.

Requirements:
- authenticated connection
- market specification optional via `market_tickers`
- supports `update_subscription` with `add_markets` and `delete_markets`

order_group_updates.title: Order Group Updates
order_group_updates.description:
Real-time order group lifecycle and limit updates. Requires authentication.

**Requirements:**
- Authentication required
- Market specification ignored
- Updates sent when order groups are created, triggered, reset, deleted, or have limits updated

**Use case:** Tracking order group lifecycle and limits

sendingTimestampMs.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when Kalshi queued this message at the network layer.

commandId.description: Unique ID of a command within a WebSocket session

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number used for snapshot/delta consistency

lastUpdateReason.description: Margin order update reason when the delta corresponds to the authenticated user's order. CloseCancel and HaltCancel are reserved; the current orderbook stream filters out these operations. The field is omitted when no reason applies.

price.description: USD price as a fixed-point decimal string (4 decimals)

rate.description: Funding rate as a decimal value.

next_funding_time_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the next funding time.

ts_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the funding snapshot.

send_initial_snapshot.description: Sends an initial snapshot for ticker subscriptions.
Sends an initial snapshot for newly added ticker subscriptions.

market_ids.description: Full list of market IDs after update

sid.description: Present when the error is scoped to a subscription.

seq.description: Present on subscription-scoped errors on sequenced channels.

code.description:
Error codes the Margin WebSocket endpoint can emit.
Numbering is shared with the Predictions WebSocket API, so the list is
not contiguous. Codes 23, 24, and 28 are used only on channels
outside the public Margin surface. Codes 6, 16, and 17 are
retired; the service no longer emits them and their numbers
stay reserved.

market_ticker.description: Optional market ticker associated with the error

market_tickers.description: Optional market tickers associated with the error

id.description: Present when replying to a get_snapshot command with an ID

price.description: Last traded price in USD as a fixed-point decimal string (4 decimals).

bid.description: USD price as a fixed-point decimal string (4 decimals).

ask.description: USD price as a fixed-point decimal string (4 decimals).

volume.description: One sided total trade volume in contracts.

volume_notional_value_dollars.description: Total notional value of one sided trade volume in dollars.

volume_24h.description: One sided trade volume in the last 24 hours in contracts.

volume_24h_notional_value_dollars.description: Total notional value of one sided trade volume in the last 24 hours in dollars.

open_interest.description: One sided open interest in contracts.

open_interest_notional_value_dollars.description: Total notional value of one sided open interest in dollars.

reference_price.description: Underlying reference index value scaled to one contract, when available (CF Benchmarks for crypto perps; Pyth for metals, commodities, and other Pyth-indexed perps). ts_ms is the index source timestamp.

order_source.description:
`system` for liquidations and margin exit or trailing-stop
triggers. `user` for every other order.

order_group_id.description: Order group identifier, if the order belongs to an order group

last_update_reason.description: Margin order update reason; ReduceOnlyCancel means reduce_only capped the order at placement. The field is omitted when no reason applies.

order_source.description:
`system` for liquidations and margin exit or trailing-stop
triggers. `user` for every other order.

contracts_limit_fp.description: Updated contracts limit in fixed-point (2 decimals). Present for "created" and "limit_updated" events only.

ts_ms.description: Matching engine timestamp at which the event was processed, as Unix epoch milliseconds.

apiKey.description: API key authentication required for margin WebSocket connections.
